name: dokantra
description: Dokantra — Run Your Shop Smarter. MERN business management platform for managing products, inventory, customers, sales, expenses, invoices, and business insights in one place.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=client && npm run build --workspace=server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=client --if-present && npm run lint --workspace=server --if-present
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --workspace=client --if-present && npm run lint:fix --workspace=server --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=client --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace=server --if-present && npm run typecheck --workspace=shared --if-present
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspace=client --if-present && npm run clean --workspace=server --if-present && npm run clean --workspace=shared --if-present && rimraf node_modules
